run_mnist_training: run the MNIST training script with Jacobian regularization on a simple MLP model
create_MLP_model: create an MLP neural network with configurable hidden layer sizes and Xavier initialization
eval_model_with_jacobian: evaluate a trained model computing supervised loss and Jacobian regularization loss
review_MLP_forward: review the MLP forward pass that flattens input and applies two ReLU layers
test_jacobian_regularization: test Jacobian regularization by training an MLP on MNIST with configurable lambda weight
